t: Ronseal Ultimate Protection Decking Stain in Country Oak offers robust defence for outdoor wooden surfaces, providing essential protection against weather damage and daily wear and tear. This advanced water-based formulation delivers comprehensive weatherproofing, alongside scuff, scratch, and anti-slip resistance, ensuring both durability and safety underfoot. It is touch-dry in 90 minutes and recoatable in 4 hours, facilitating swift project completion for trade professionals working on garden decking and other outdoor timber areas. 2.5Ltr tin covers approximately 20m², offering efficient coverage for various projects.
